name: tower
description: A web cockpit and a /tower pane over every Claude Code agent across your repos: see who needs you, approve and answer, send prompts and slash commands, start workstreams in git worktrees, and watch changes and PRs. Plus desktop notifications and a status line.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Notify when a session needs you: a permission prompt, a question, or a long turn finishing.

notifyOnDone.title: Notify when a turn finishes
notifyOnDone.description: Send a notification when a main-loop turn ends after running at least minTurnSeconds.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Shorter turns finish without a notification.

notifyOnIdle.title: Notify on idle reminders
notifyOnIdle.description: Also notify when Claude Code reminds you the session is waiting for input.

remoteAnswers.title: Answer from the tower
remoteAnswers.description: Which sessions send their permission prompts and questions to the tower instead of the terminal: launched (sessions the tower started), always, or never.

inboxSeconds.title: Cockpit inbox check (seconds)
inboxSeconds.description: How often this session checks for prompts and answers sent from the cockpit. 0 turns it off.

pollSeconds.title: Tower refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the tower re-reads the list of running sessions, once /tower has been opened in this session.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show folder, branch, model, effort, mode, context and cost at the bottom.

showBranch.title: Status line: git branch
showBranch.description: The current branch after the folder, with * when there are uncommitted changes.

showContext.title: Status line: context fill
showContext.description: How full the context window is.

showCost.title: Status line: session cost
showCost.description: Spend so far this session, where the account reports it.

statusSeconds.title: Status line refresh (seconds)
statusSeconds.description: How often branch, context and cost are re-read between turns.
